HOSTELS
Boys Hostels
About
The Boys Hostel at KUCET is designed to provide a safe, secure, and student-friendly environment for male students pursuing various technical courses. The hostel promotes discipline and community living, allowing students to grow both academically and socially.
Accommodation Details:
The Boys Hostel comprises
1 main hostel
divided into
3 blocks
. It can accommodate a total of
600 students
, with
4 students per room
. Rooms are well-ventilated and adequately furnished to ensure comfort and functionality.
Facilities Provided:
24x7 Water Supply
Dispensary
Hostel Infrastructure:
Hostel | Rooms Available | No. of Students / Room | To Be Occupied
ENGG. HOSTEL | 62 | 4 | 248
HALLS | 4 | 10 | 40
Student Life:
The hostel encourages a lively and inclusive atmosphere. Students participate in cultural activities, tech fests, and sports events. Cleanliness drives and community service events are also held regularly to build a sense of responsibility.
